adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController, `before_filter :ensure_embeddable` runs before `best`, so `params.require(:embed_url)` is not reached if `ensure_embeddable` raises first. `ensure_embeddable` raises when `SiteSetting.embeddable_host.blank?` (and the default in `site_settings.yml` is `''`, i.e., blank). Therefore the spec `it "is 404 without an embed_url" do; get :best; response.should_not be_success; end` will fail (non-success) due to the filter, even if the missing `embed_url` check were removed. This is a real, diff-grounded test-quality issue rather than a runtime defect.
